<INSTRUCTIONS>
# AGENTS.md

## Project overview

Flutter smart wearable app (`smart_device_app`) with a multi-app assembly architecture. Multiple app variants (demo, smartwear) are built from modular SDK components defined in YAML. Native platform code in Kotlin (Android) and Swift (iOS).

## Critical workflow: code generation

**Run `dart tools/generate_app.dart --app <id>` before any build or CI step.** This generates:
- Dart customer profiles in `lib/customer_profiles/`
- Native manifests in `apps/<id>/generated/`
- Android Kotlin module config, Gradle module config, MainActivity, Application class, AndroidManifest.xml
- iOS Swift module config, native services, channel registry, xcconfig, Info.plist, PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy

CI runs this for both `demo` and `smartwear` before `flutter analyze`. If generated files are stale, analyze will fail.

```
dart tools/generate_app.dart --app demo
dart tools/generate_app.dart --app smartwear
```

Other tools:
- `dart tools/create_app.dart --id <id> --name <name>` — scaffold a new app variant
- `dart tools/package_app.dart --app <id> --build android-apk|android-aab|ios` — build with preflight checks

## Module system

SDK modules are defined in `sdk_modules/*.yaml` with explicit dependency declarations. `generate_app.dart` resolves the transitive dependency graph. Module IDs map to:
- Dart: `lib/feature_kit/` and `lib/platform_api/` directories
- Android: `android/app/src/main/kotlin/com/smartdevice/wear/native/` subdirectories
- iOS: `ios/Runner/NativeModules/` subdirectories

App configs in `apps/<id>/app.yaml` list which modules to include. Features can be excluded per app variant.

## Entrypoints

- `lib/main.dart` — default (smartwear, hardcoded)
- `lib/main_smartwear.dart` — smartwear with env config (`--dart-define` flags)
- `lib/main_demo.dart` — demo variant with env config

Build with a specific entrypoint: `flutter build apk -t lib/main_smartwear.dart`

## Directory structure

```
lib/
  app/              # App shell, router, bootstrapper, env, theme
  app_shell/        # Per-app shell pages (demo/, smartwear/, templates/)
  core/             # Shared infra: cache, database, logging, network, storage, sync, UI
  core_sdk/         # SDK service layer (device connection, search)
  customer_profiles/ # GENERATED — app profiles and module configs
  data/             # Repositories (local/, remote/)
  feature_kit/      # Modular feature implementations
  features/         # Feature UI pages
  l10n/             # Localization ARB files (Chinese-first: app_zh.arb is template)
  platform_api/     # Native platform channel wrappers
  protocol/         # BLE protocol adapters
  shared/           # Shared widgets and utilities
```

## Lint and analyze

Strict mode enabled: `strict-casts`, `strict-inference`, `strict-raw-types`. ~100 additional lint rules. Key non-obvious rules:
- `always_use_package_imports` — no relative imports
- `avoid_print` — use `AppLogger` wrapper
- `public_member_api_docs` — doc comments required on public APIs
- `require_trailing_commas` — enforced
- `unawaited_futures` — all futures must be awaited or explicitly ignored

Analyzer excludes generated code: `lib/**.freezed.dart`, `lib/**.g.dart`, `lib/l10n/**`.

## Code generation (build_runner)

```bash
dart run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs
```

Generates: freezed (`.freezed.dart`), json_serializable (`.g.dart`), drift (database), hive (type adapters).

## Pre-commit hooks (lefthook)

```bash
brew install lefthook && lefthook install
```

Hooks run in parallel:
1. `dart format --set-exit-if-changed` on staged `.dart` files
2. `flutter analyze --fatal-infos --fatal-warnings`
3. `detekt` on staged `.kt`/`.kts` files (from `android/`)
4. `swiftlint` on staged `.swift` files
5. Blocks `debugPrint`, `print`, `NSLog`, `FIXME`, `STOPSHIP` in staged code

Commit messages must match: `type(scope): description` where type is one of: feat, fix, docs, style, refactor, test, chore, perf, ci, build, revert.

## CI pipeline (.github/workflows/ci.yml)

Three parallel jobs:
1. **Flutter**: pub get → generate_app (demo + smartwear) → analyze → format check → test --coverage → upload coverage
2. **Android**: pub get → detekt → gradle test → flutter build apk --debug
3. **iOS**: swiftlint → pub get → xcodebuild test → flutter build ios --simulator --debug --no-codesign

## Testing

```bash
flutter test                    # all unit/widget tests
flutter test --coverage         # with coverage
flutter test test/features/     # single directory
flutter test test/path/to/file.dart  # single file
```

Integration tests in `integration_test/` (pairing flow, device control flow).

## Localization

Template: `lib/l10n/app_zh.arb` (Chinese). Generated class: `AppLocalizations`. Run `flutter gen-l10n` or it auto-generates with `flutter: generate: true` in pubspec.

## Android specifics

- Detekt config: `android/detekt.yml` — `maxIssues: 0`, `warningsAsErrors: true`, `maxLineLength: 140`
- Kotlin indent: 4 spaces, line length: 140
- Maven repos use Alibaba mirrors (aliyun.com)

## iOS specifics

- SwiftLint config: `.swiftlint.yml` — `force_cast`, `force_try`, `force_unwrapping` are errors
- Swift indent: 4 spaces, line length: 140 (warning) / 180 (error)
- Codegen writes `ios/Flutter/AppModules.xcconfig` and includes it in Debug/Release xcconfig
- `ios/Runner/NativeModules/SdkModuleConfig.swift` and `IosNativeServices.swift` are generated

## Coverage

Codecov configured (`.codecov.yml`): patch coverage ≥ 70%, project drop ≤ 2%. Generated files excluded from coverage.

## Development rules

**`RULES.md`** contains mandatory rules for all code changes — state management, layer dependencies, error handling, i18n, testing, and commit conventions. Read it before making any changes.

## Docs

- `RULES.md` — mandatory development rules (state management, layers, error handling, i18n, testing)
- `docs/项目优化规划.md` — optimization roadmap (4 phases)
- `docs/项目交接文档.md` — project handoff / full architecture overview
- `docs/架构与边界Review.md` — architecture decisions and risk analysis
- `docs/新客户App接入指南.md` — new customer app onboarding
- `docs/Flutter原生边界.md` — Flutter/native boundary
- `docs/原生通道契约.md` — MethodChannel/EventChannel contracts
- `docs/错误码.md` — error code definitions
- `docs/JSON模型规范.md` — freezed + json_serializable conventions
- `docs/文档索引.md` — full document index
